⚠️ WARNING: don’t read if you’re not ready for some raw, honest, tough love (that will make you MUCH happier in the end)

1. The person you talk to the most is yourself. If you learn how to speak kinder to yourself, life will magically get better — I promise. 
2. Your fear of disappointing people (aka people pleasing) is hurting you more than you realize. Learn how to be honest and direct with people—they appreciate it. 
3. There is healthy conflict and unhealthy conflict. You probably saw a lot of unhealthy conflict growing up. That’s ok. Make today the day you start to learn about healthy conflict. 
4. “Talk like a man” is the worst communication advice for women. Talk like yourself. Be articulate, direct, and concise. 
5. Humor is a super weapon that’s grossly underutilized. It’s usually not that serious. Everything’s made up. 
6. Half of your “buts” should be “ands”. Ex: you like working here AND (not but) you need a raise. Small difference, huge impact. 
7. They might be micromanaging you because they’re a bad boss… but they might be micromanaging you because you’re a bad employee. Either way, have a conversation about it—today. 
8. Your unregulated nervous system is why you get flustered at work. Work on regulation and a million other issues will dissolve. 
9. You’re always seeking other’s opinions because you don’t trust yourself. 
10. Being loud doesn’t mean you’re right and being super serious doesn’t mean you’re smart 
11. When in doubt, err on the side of overcommunication. If you can ask Google, don’t ask someone else.
12. Apologize. Then, ONLY if it can alleviate the hurt, add context. Dont make excuses.

Hello Please I am seeking guidance of professionals to make a better decision in my life please I need your assistance and thoughts to make a better decision please.

I’m a 23-year-old BSCS student in my 7th semester with only two semesters left before graduation. I chose Computer Science without proper career counseling and, despite maintaining a 3.17 CGPA, completing multiple certifications, and building AI/Data Science projects, I’ve never genuinely enjoyed programming or coding. In fact, I often feel stressed and disconnected from the field, because before taking admission in BSCS to be honest I take basic web-development classes like html, css, little how JS, trust me at the same spot within 2 weeks I realise that buddy this field not aligns with you. But due to negative thoughts like what my parents think about me if I not take admission, what my village people think about me, as a belong to small village I was due to the temptation of cities and dreaming of building a good standard life I accidentally take admission in BSCS, if I take admission in BS sports tryst me I cover any difficult obstacle. Now I am stuck only 8 months remaining to complete my degree what I have to do further I have no idea. Please I need assistance 

The one thing I consistently enjoy is fitness. I love working out, learning about health, filming, editing videos, and the idea of building a fitness content brand on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. My current plan is to finish my BSCS degree, work a full-time job for financial stability, and dedicate my free time to fitness content creation for the next few years.

I also have a strong interest in creating motivational and self-improvement content. Over the last four years, I’ve struggled with stress, self-doubt, and the challenge of pursuing a field that never truly aligned with my interests. That experience has given me a real story to share. I want to turn those lessons, failures, and personal growth into meaningful content that could inspire others facing similar situations, similar to creators who share life lessons and personal development journeys.

My biggest confusion is whether I should continue trying to build a career in AI/Computer Science, move toward a management/business-related field, or focus on growing a fitness channel or either motivational content brand like jayshetty etc alongside a stable job.

Has anyone been in a similar situation? I’d genuinely appreciate any advice on how to make this decision wisely without regretting it later. Thank you.

I need assistance what I have to choose at this situation please, your thought on this situation help me to make more better decision please.
